text: Block 1 re-aimed at the 2027 Open (athlete-approved 2026-11-22): goal strict pull-ups 10 -> 12.5 (guardrails Sorensen >= 60 s, 10-min bike >= 119 cal); hinge keeps progressing as a main lift and is a Block 2 focus. Skill ladders (olympic, kipping, overhead) get ~2 exposures/week from week 1; weeks 9-11 (Jan 18 - Feb 7) are the Open-prep phase (strength to maintenance, 3 metcons/wk). Realistic 2027 Open: Rx where movements are unlocked, Scaled otherwise; 2028 Quarterfinals stays the long-term target. Athlete agrees to the 30-min run TT in the March transition week.
